title: JBBQ: Japanese Bias Benchmark for Analyzing Social Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice Question Answering (QA) tasks using the JBBQ dataset to measure stereotyping behavior toward groups based on age (e.g., cognitive decline) in ambiguous versus disambiguated contexts.
Multiple-choice QA tasks assessing whether models rely on stereotypes regarding disability status (e.g., intelligence levels of people with physical disabilities) when context is ambiguous.
Multiple-choice QA tasks evaluating stereotypes related to gender identity, including specific Japanese concepts like X-gender, by comparing model outputs in ambiguous and disambiguated scenarios.
Multiple-choice QA tasks measuring stereotypes associated with physical characteristics (e.g., body weight, height) adapted to Japanese cultural contexts.
Multiple-choice QA tasks assessing stereotypes regarding sexual orientation (e.g., gay, lesbian) by analyzing model predictions in the absence of disambiguating information.
